REJECTIONS.NAME: Beta Italia (betaitalia.it) — presumed sugar-beet research body
REJECTIONS.REASON_AS_REPORTED: THE MOST IMPORTANT REJECTION OF THIS RUN, and a direct repeat of the image-line.com trap. BARBABIETOLA is the radar's heaviest crop (239 label pairs) and 'Beta' is the interprofessional sugar-beet research company that runs Italy's official beet trials, so betaitalia.it looked like the single highest-value seed on this axis. A WebSearch even asserted that betaitalia.it 'is the official site you were looking for'. I fetched it: 200 / 445159 bytes, and the title is 'Beta Italia - Cucina, Casa e Giardinaggio'. Word-boundary counts on the retrieved body: barbabietola 0, bieticol 0, zucchero 0, sperimentaz 0, agronom 0, Coprob 0 — against ricetta 99 and cucina 58. The H2 blocks are 'Articoli Recenti' / 'Ultimi Articoli'. The domain now serves a recipe and lifestyle content farm; the only instagram/linkedin URLs on it are sharer widgets, not owned handles. Registering it would have put a cooking blog into the canonical registry as the authority on ADAMA's number-one crop. Where the real Beta research body now publishes is NAO_SEI — I did not find a verified replacement host in this run, and that is absence in my reading, not absence in the world.
